app_key.label: Bose SoundTouch app key
app_key.description: Optional. A Bose SoundTouch developer app key enables sending announcements to the speaker as an overlay that ducks the current music and resumes it afterwards. Leave empty to disable native announcements (they then play through the linked playback protocol instead).

preset_media_type.label: Preset {0} media type
preset_media_type.description: Type of media used for this preset's search and playback.

preset_search.label: Preset {0} search
preset_search.description: Type a search term, then press Search.

preset_media.label: Preset {0} to play
preset_media.description: URI copied from the selected result or manually entered. Pressing this preset button on any of your SoundTouch speakers plays it on that speaker.

manifest.description: Control Bose SoundTouch speakers and map their physical preset buttons to Music Assistant content.
